html:
SMTO-CMP-0040 — The AI's last message needs your decision, so the task isn't done

GUID: 1335b73b-0b9b-4234-b8b2-4d1a46491b3b
Slug: completion-ask-user-required
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • The AI ended with a question for you, such as which option to use, so the task isn't really finished. SMTO asked the AI to ask you properly, so your answer can continue the same task.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look for a question from SMTO in the conversation, marked Needs input or Your reply is needed, and answer it there. Answering SMTO's question lets the same task continue where it stopped.
  2. If the task stopped as Partial · resumable instead, read the AI's last message and reply in the conversation with your decision. Your reply gives the AI the choice it was waiting for.
  3. Before you approve a change the AI suggests, expand the task to check what it has already done. This avoids approving a change that already happened.

What success looks like

  • The AI continues with your choice and the task ends as Completed.

If it still fails

  • Open Technical details, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't approve the same change twice; check the task's steps first.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Completion was rejected because terminal-control inspection found an explicit same-run continuation or choice request in the assistant's final prose, which must go through ask_user (or repeated control corrections reached the retry bound).

What this means

  • Terminal-control inspection detects language requiring a user continuation/choice, or bounded recovery cannot route that interaction through ask_user. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Terminal-control inspection detects language requiring a user continuation/choice, or bounded recovery cannot route that interaction through ask_user.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the detected continuation signal and use the existing ask_user interaction identity.

How to fix it

  • Inspect completion_feedback (reason terminal_continuation_requires_ask_user and the detected signal) and the completion.rejected events. The model must use ask_user for a required decision or finish without soliciting one; if protocol.completion_retry_bound stopped the run as partial, the user can reply in the conversation or resume, and existing receipts remain intact.
  • Resolve the pending user question through the existing interaction flow before completion.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • The required user decision is obtained through the supported interaction flow before final completion.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors
